description: Issue signed receipts for AI agent actions; verify any receipt offline - free, no account.
name: com.pcrzero/mcp

environmentVariables.description: Set to http to enable streamable-http transport (default stdio).
environmentVariables.name: PCRZERO_MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP auth mode: client_key (default, per-request API key header — required for remote/Bazaar) or env_key (loopback sidecar only).
environmentVariables.name: PCRZERO_MCP_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Optional process env API key for env_key (loopback) mode only. Never used as a shared multi-client key in client_key mode. issue_receipt always requires a key.
environmentVariables.name: PCRZERO_API_KEY
